messages:
marta: Proposal: a tiny "cost lighthouse" tile on Console that shows per-route per-model unit econ (median cost/token 1h, 24h avg), tokens saved by cache (winner-only), and a fallback delta. Quick signal, not billing.
li: +1. Include a confidence indicator for sampled tenants.
samir: Impl plan: minute-level MV keyed by (route, model, minute) with tokens_total, tokens_cached_winner, invocations, fallback_count, sample_factor.
ben: We must add cache_winner to ingestion to avoid double-counting prefix+KV hits. Backfill plan needed.
li: Sampling: full-res for top-K tenants, reservoir sampling for mid, 0.5% for long tail. Store sample_factor for extrapolation.
emma: UX: 280px tile, sparkline, two numbers (1h median, 24h avg), color ribbon for confidence, canary vs baseline diff when rollout active.
marta: Rollout guard: show projected 24h burn and a cost-aware rollback link if delta > 2x. devex-bot will surface suggestion.
devex-bot: NOTE: rollback suggestion requires feature-flag 'econ-ops-suggestions' and IAM scope econ.rollback.
samir: MV SQL sketch: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW econ_minute_preagg AS SELECT route_id, model_sku, date_trunc('minute', ts) minute, SUM(tokens) tokens_total, SUM(CASE WHEN cache_winner THEN tokens ELSE 0 END) tokens_cached_winner, COUNT(1) invocations, SUM(is_fallback::int) fallback_count, AVG(sample_factor) sample_factor FROM token_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1,2,3;
ben: Infra will expose /internal/econ/lighthouse?route=&model=&since= returning compressed preagg rows, SLA <=2m. Pagination + filters required.
li: I'll write copy explaining engineer-signal vs invoice and how to read confidence.
emma: I'll mock the tile and the canary diff view and post in #design.
marta: Action items: samir add cache_winner + migration/backfill plan; ben prototype MV+API stub; li doc copy; emma mocks. I'll draft a 1-pager and post here tomorrow.
ben: I'll also return a canned API payload so frontend can iterate without prod data.
samir: I'll start a sim dataset and PR for ingestion changes.
marta: Thanks all. Any concerns?
